templates.subject: Your {{TRIP_NAME}} application has started
templates.emailBody:
Hi {{PARTICIPANT_FIRST_NAME}},

Thank you for starting your application for {{TRIP_NAME}} in {{TRIP_LOCATION}}, {{TRIP_START_DATE}} to {{TRIP_END_DATE}}.

Your application is saved, so you can come back and finish it at any time. When every section is complete, submit it and our team will review it.

If you have questions, contact your trip leader, {{LEADER_FIRST_NAME}} {{LEADER_LAST_NAME}}, at {{LEADER_EMAIL}}.

Blessings,
{{ORG_NAME}}
{{ORG_WEBSITE}}

templates.subject: Reminder: finish your {{TRIP_NAME}} application
templates.emailBody:
Hi {{PARTICIPANT_FIRST_NAME}},

Your application for {{TRIP_NAME}} ({{TRIP_START_DATE}} to {{TRIP_END_DATE}}) is not finished yet. Please log in, complete the remaining sections, and submit it so we can hold your place on the team.

Need help? Reach {{LEADER_FIRST_NAME}} {{LEADER_LAST_NAME}} at {{LEADER_EMAIL}} or {{LEADER_PHONE}}.

Thank you,
{{ORG_NAME}}

templates.subject: We received your {{TRIP_NAME}} application
You're approved for {{TRIP_NAME}}!
Deposit due for {{TRIP_NAME}}
templates.emailBody:
Hi {{PARTICIPANT_FIRST_NAME}},

This is a reminder that a deposit of {{TRIP_DEPOSIT}} is due to secure your place on {{TRIP_NAME}} ({{TRIP_START_DATE}} to {{TRIP_END_DATE}}).

So far, {{PARTICIPANT_AMOUNT_RAISED}} has been raised toward your trip. You can find giving and payment information at {{ORG_WEBSITE}}.

If you have questions about your deposit, contact {{LEADER_FIRST_NAME}} {{LEADER_LAST_NAME}} at {{LEADER_EMAIL}}.

Thank you,
{{ORG_NAME}}

templates.subject: Deposit received for {{TRIP_NAME}}
Balance reminder for {{TRIP_NAME}}
Your {{TRIP_NAME}} trip is fully paid
templates.emailBody:
Hi {{PARTICIPANT_FIRST_NAME}},

Great news: your trip to {{TRIP_LOCATION}} for {{TRIP_NAME}} is fully paid. A total of {{PARTICIPANT_AMOUNT_RAISED}} has been given toward your trip.

Thank you, and please thank everyone who supported you. We look forward to serving alongside you from {{TRIP_START_DATE}} to {{TRIP_END_DATE}}.

Blessings,
{{ORG_NAME}}

templates.subject: A donation was given toward your {{TRIP_NAME}} trip
Getting ready for {{TRIP_NAME}}
templates.emailBody:
Hi {{PARTICIPANT_FIRST_NAME}},

{{TRIP_NAME}} begins on {{TRIP_START_DATE}}, and we can't wait to serve with you in {{TRIP_LOCATION}}. Before you go, please check that:

- Your passport is valid and uploaded
- All required documents in your profile are complete
- Your flight details are confirmed
- You have packed for the trip, returning {{TRIP_END_DATE}}

Your trip leader is {{LEADER_FIRST_NAME}} {{LEADER_LAST_NAME}}. Save their contact details for travel days: {{LEADER_EMAIL}}, {{LEADER_PHONE}}.

Safe travels,
{{ORG_NAME}}

templates.subject: Your {{TRIP_NAME}} financial statement
An update from {{ORG_NAME}}
templates.emailBody:
Hi {{PARTICIPANT_FIRST_NAME}},

Thank you for serving with {{ORG_NAME}}. We wanted to share some news with you.

[Write your update here.]

If you have any questions, reply to this email or contact us at {{ORG_EMAIL}} or {{ORG_PHONE}}. You can find more information at {{ORG_WEBSITE}}.

Thank you,
{{ORG_NAME}}
